verses.en: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;
verses.pt: E aconteceu que, quando Jesus acabou essas palavras, partiu da Galileia, e veio para a região da Judeia, além do Jordão.
verses.en_web: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee, and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.
verses.en_bbe: And it came about that after saying these words, Jesus went away from Galilee, and came into the parts of Judaea on the other side of Jordan.

verses.en: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
verses.pt: E muitas multidões o seguiram, e ele os curou ali.
verses.en_web: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.
verses.en_bbe: And a great number went after him; and he made them well there.

verses.en: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
verses.pt: Então os fariseus se aproximaram dele e, provando-o, perguntaram-lhe: É lícito ao homem se divorciar da sua mulher por qualquer causa?
verses.en_web: Pharisees came to him, testing him, and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
verses.en_bbe: And certain Pharisees came to him, testing him, and saying, Is it right for a man to put away his wife for every cause?

verses.en: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,
verses.pt: Porém ele lhes respondeu: Não tendes lido que aquele que os fez no princípio, macho e fêmea os fez,
verses.en_web: He answered, “Haven’t you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,
verses.en_bbe: And he said in answer, Have you not seen in the Writings, that he who made them at the first made them male and female, and said,

verses.en: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?
verses.pt: e disse: Portanto o homem deixará pai e mãe, e se unirá a sua mulher, e os dois serão uma única carne? Gênesis 2:24
verses.en_web: and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh?’
verses.en_bbe: For this cause will a man go away from his father and mother, and be joined to his wife; and the two will become one flesh?

verses.en: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
verses.pt: Assim eles já não são mais dois, mas sim uma única carne; portanto, o que Deus juntou, o ser humano não separe.
verses.en_web: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”
verses.en_bbe: So that they are no longer two, but one flesh. Then let not that which has been joined by God be parted by man.

verses.en: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?
verses.pt: Eles lhe disseram: Por que, pois, Moisés mandou lhe dar carta de separação, e divorciar-se dela?
verses.en_web: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a bill of divorce, and divorce her?”
verses.en_bbe: They say to him, Why then did Moses give orders that a husband might give her a statement in writing and be free from her?

verses.en: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
verses.pt: Jesus lhes disse: Por causa da dureza dos vossos corações Moisés vos permitiu divorciardes de vossas mulheres; mas no princípio não foi assim.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.
verses.en_bbe: He says to them, Moses, because of your hard hearts, let you put away your wives: but it has not been so from the first.

verses.en: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.
verses.pt: Porém eu vos digo que qualquer um que se divorciar de sua mulher, a não ser por causa de pecado sexual, e se casar com outra, adultera; e o que se casar com a divorciada também adultera.
verses.en_web: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.”
verses.en_bbe: And I say to you, Whoever puts away his wife for any other cause than the loss of her virtue, and takes another, is a false husband: and he who takes her as his wife when she is put away, is no true husband to her.

verses.en: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.
verses.pt: Os seus discípulos lhe disseram: Se assim é a condição do homem com a mulher, não convém se casar.
verses.en_web: His disciples said to him, “If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.”
verses.en_bbe: The disciples say to him, If this is the position of a man in relation to his wife, it is better not to be married.

verses.en: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.
verses.pt: Porém ele lhes disse: Nem todos recebem esta palavra, a não ser aqueles a quem é dado;
verses.en_web: But he said to them, “Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.
verses.en_bbe: But he said to them, Not all men are able to take in this saying, but only those to whom it is given.

verses.en: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother’s womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven’s sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.
verses.pt: Pois há castrados que nasceram assim do ventre da mãe; e há castrados que foram castrados pelos homens; e há castrados que castraram a si mesmos por causa do Reino dos céus. Quem pode receber isto,receba.
verses.en_web: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven’s sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.”
verses.en_bbe: For there are men who, from birth, were without sex: and there are some who were made so by men: and there are others who have made themselves so for the kingdom of heaven. He who is able to take it, let him take it.

verses.en: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
verses.pt: Então lhe trouxeram crianças, para que pusesse as mãos sobre elas e orasse, mas os discípulos os repreendiam.
verses.en_web: Then little children were brought to him, that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.
verses.en_bbe: Then some people took little children to him, so that he might put his hands on them in blessing: and the disciples said sharp words to them.

verses.en: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.pt: Mas Jesus disse: Deixai as crianças, e não as impeçais de vir a mim, porque delas é o Reino dos céus.
verses.en_web: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”
verses.en_bbe: But Jesus said, Let the little ones come to me, and do not keep them away: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.

verses.en: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
verses.pt: Ele pôs as mãos sobre elas, e depois partiu-se dali.
verses.en_web: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.
verses.en_bbe: And he put his hands on them, and went away.

verses.en: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
verses.pt: E eis que alguém se aproximou, e perguntou-lhe: “Bom Mestre, que bem farei para eu ter a vida eterna?”
verses.en_web: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”
verses.en_bbe: And one came to him and said, Master, what good thing have I to do, so that I may have eternal life?

verses.en: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.
verses.pt: E ele lhe disse: “Por que me chamas bom? Ninguém há bom, a não ser um: Deus. Porém, se queres entrar na vida, guarda os mandamentos.”
verses.en_web: He said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to him, Why are you questioning me about what is good? One there is who is good: but if you have a desire to go into life, keep the rules of the law.

verses.en: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,
verses.pt: Perguntou-lhe ele: “Quais?” E Jesus respondeu: “Não cometerás homicídio, não adulterarás, não furtarás, não darás falso testemunho;
verses.en_web: He said to him, “Which ones?” Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder.’ ‘You shall not commit adultery.’ ‘You shall not steal.’ ‘You shall not offer false testimony.’
verses.en_bbe: He says to him, Which? And Jesus said, Do not put anyone to death, Do not be untrue in married life, Do not take what is not yours, Do not give false witness,

verses.en: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.pt: honra ao teu pai e à tua mãe; e amarás ao teu próximo como a ti mesmo.”
verses.en_web: ‘Honor your father and your mother.’ And, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’”
verses.en_bbe: Give honour to your father and your mother: and, Have love for your neighbour as for yourself.

verses.en: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?
verses.pt: O rapaz lhe disse: “Tenho guardado tudo isso desde a minha juventude. Que me falta ainda?”
verses.en_web: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”
verses.en_bbe: The young man says to him, All these things have I done: what more is there?

verses.en: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: “Se queres ser completo, vai, vende o que tens, e dá aos pobres. Assim terás um tesouro no céu. Então vem, segue-me.”
verses.en_web: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.”
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said to him, If you have a desire to be complete, go, get money for your property, and give it to the poor, and you will have wealth in heaven: and come after me.

verses.en: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.
verses.pt: Mas quando o rapaz ouviu essa palavra, foi embora triste, porque tinha muitos bens.
verses.en_web: But when the young man heard the saying, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.
verses.en_bbe: But hearing these words the young man went away sorrowing: for he had much property.

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.pt: Jesus, então, disse aos seus discípulos: “Em verdade vos digo que dificilmente um rico entrará no reino dos céus.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to his disciples, “Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus said to his disciples, Truly I say to you, It is hard for a man with much money to go into the kingdom of heaven.

verses.en: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.pt: Aliás, eu vos digo que é mais fácil um camelo passar pela abertura de uma agulha do que o rico entrar no reino de Deus.”
verses.en_web: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”
verses.en_bbe: And again I say to you, It is simpler for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a man with much money to go into the kingdom of God.

verses.en: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
verses.pt: Quando os seus discípulos ouviram isso, espantaram-se muito, e disseram: “Quem, pois, pode se salvar?”
verses.en_web: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”
verses.en_bbe: And the disciples, hearing this, were greatly surprised, saying, Who then may have salvation?

verses.en: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
verses.pt: Jesus olhou para eles,e lhes respondeu: Para os seres humanos, isto é impossível; mas para Deus tudo é possível.
verses.en_web: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus, looking at them, said, With men this is not possible; but with God all things are possible.

verses.en: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?
verses.pt: Então Pedro se pôs a falar, e lhe perguntou: Eis que deixamos tudo, e te seguimos; o que, pois, conseguiremos ter?
verses.en_web: Then Peter answered, “Behold, we have left everything, and followed you. What then will we have?”
verses.en_bbe: Then Peter said to him, See, we have given up everything and have come after you; what then will we have?

verses.en: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.pt: E Jesus lhes disse: Em verdade vos digo que vós que me seguistes, na regeneração, quando o Filho do homem se sentar no trono de sua glória, vós também vos sentareis sobre doze tronos, para julgar as doze tribos de Israel.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that you who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Man will sit on the throne of his glory, you also will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus said to them, Truly I say to you that in the time when all things are made new, and the Son of man is seated in his glory, you who have come after me will be seated on twelve seats, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.en: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.
verses.pt: E qualquer um que houver deixado casas, ou irmãos, ou irmãs, ou pai, ou mãe, ou mulher, ou filhos, ou terras por causa do meu nome, receberá cem vezes tanto, e herdará a vida eterna.
verses.en_web: Everyone who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, will receive one hundred times, and will inherit eternal life.
verses.en_bbe: And everyone who has given up houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or child, or land, for my name, will be given a hundred times as much, and have eternal life.

verses.en: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.
verses.pt: Porém muitos primeiros serão últimos; e últimos, primeiros.
verses.en_web: But many will be last who are first; and first who are last.
verses.en_bbe: But a great number who are first will be last, and some who are last will be first.
